charge.name: annie
charge.note: WCSim's quantum efficiency (Multi_Tank_Types, QEratio included) applied after absorption, from the detector's value sets (lumen's own reading, at hc / E; WCSim's wavelength 2 pi 197.3 / E is 1.3e-4 shorter). A cross-check, reported and not gated: ANNIE's WCSim (Geant4 10.1.3) loses 7 to 8 % of the light against Geant4 10.7.4 (g4ref and lumen agree), at the inner-structure frame (a G4TessellatedSolid): g4min on the repaired original GDML (gdml-repaired annie_v2.gdml, the file WCSim's export repaired and annie_g4's original run read), 1e6 photons, Geant4 10.1.3 kills 462,351 of 2,562,305 photon entries into the frame by absorption inside it (18 %), 10.7.4 64 of 949,299; 10.7.4 on the overlap-free export (annie-g4ref-export) gives every fate and hit photon for photon as on the original, so the overlap moves none of 10.7.4's light (10.1.3 aborts on the export: 'Surface Normal returned by Solid is not a Unit Vector'). annie_g4 gates. lumen / WCSim is 1.076 +- 0.0015 (chi2/ndf 6.5-7.5) since this entry stopped scaling the frame's REFLECTIVITY by 0.8182 to fold that loss in (the 0.1.3 record's 1.003 had the scale; restored on 2026-11-18's code it gives 1.0034 +- 0.0014, chi2/ndf 0.86-0.98)
